text: A module step fails when its entry leaves a callback scheduled on the event loop (#871). The step ran an async entry on a fresh loop and closed it, failing on unfinished coroutines and tasks, and said nothing of a callback set with call_later or call_at, or with call_soon from the loop's last batch: closing the loop discarded it, so the step's after-state left out what a server's running loop goes on to do. The audit passed the gate, every state and every step, for an entry whose callback broke the model's bound in production. A callback that runs before the entry's awaitable finishes is part of the step, and a cancelled one does nothing. The collector reads the loop's ready and timed queues, which only asyncio's own loop has, so an event loop policy that makes another kind is refused with that reason.
